# Awesome CUA

> Awesome CUA (Awesome Computer-Use Agents) is a source-backed catalog of computer-use, GUI, browser and mobile agents: 5,347 curated resources (1,718 papers and surveys, 3,629 models, datasets, benchmarks, agents, frameworks, tools and products), each reviewed against a primary source with evidence, review dates and separate license declarations. 1,190 metadata-only bibliography records await relevance review and are labeled separately.

Code, data, weights and document licenses are separate. Every resource, category, topic and research-library page has a Markdown version at `index.md` beside it, and every resource page its complete record at `record.json`. Read any item by id: `curl -sL https://awesomecua.com/resources/<id>/index.md` (for example `https://awesomecua.com/resources/arxiv-2404-07972/index.md`; papers also read with `hf papers read 2404.07972`).

## Catalog by kind

- [Models and checkpoints](https://awesomecua.com/categories/model/index.md): 475 curated records
- [Datasets](https://awesomecua.com/categories/dataset/index.md): 278 curated records
- [Benchmarks](https://awesomecua.com/categories/benchmark/index.md): 309 curated records
- [Agents](https://awesomecua.com/categories/agent/index.md): 479 curated records
- [Frameworks](https://awesomecua.com/categories/framework/index.md): 672 curated records
- [Infrastructure](https://awesomecua.com/categories/infrastructure/index.md): 122 curated records
- [Tools](https://awesomecua.com/categories/tool/index.md): 1,162 curated records
- [Products](https://awesomecua.com/categories/product/index.md): 75 curated records
- [Publishers](https://awesomecua.com/categories/company/index.md): 19 curated records
- [Learning resources](https://awesomecua.com/categories/learning/index.md): 38 curated records
- [Surveys](https://awesomecua.com/categories/survey/index.md): 37 curated records
- [Research papers](https://awesomecua.com/categories/paper/index.md): 1,681 curated records; listed 60 per page in the research library below

## Static API

Versioned JSON and CSV under https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/; every file carries `version` and `generated_at`.

- [API documentation](https://awesomecua.com/api/index.md): endpoints, fields, review states and versioning; the JSON and CSV files are listed under Optional

## Agent and RAG access

```sh
git clone https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-CUA.git
```

- [Data downloads](https://awesomecua.com/data/index.md)
- [Agent instructions](https://awesomecua.com/AGENTS.md): read commands, API, search pattern, BibTeX; also at https://awesomecua.com/agents.md and https://awesomecua.com/agents.txt
- [Human and agent guide](https://awesomecua.com/agents/index.md)
- [中文指南](https://awesomecua.com/zh/agents/index.md)

## Guides and policies

- [What are computer-use agents?](https://awesomecua.com/guides/what-are-computer-use-agents/index.md): Understand the observe–plan–act loop, how GUI agents differ from browser automation, and which research resources help you get started.
- [How to choose a GUI-agent benchmark](https://awesomecua.com/guides/gui-agent-benchmarks/index.md): Compare desktop task execution, browser workflows, mobile environments, and GUI grounding, and preserve the evaluation conditions needed for meaningful comparisons.
- [Where to find training data for GUI agents](https://awesomecua.com/guides/gui-agent-training-data/index.md): Distinguish grounding examples, interaction trajectories, screen understanding data, and benchmark tasks, with primary dataset sources and separate licensing checks.
- [Editorial policy](https://awesomecua.com/about/index.md): review states, inclusion boundary and corrections
- [Coverage ledger](https://awesomecua.com/coverage/index.md): source populations and known gaps
- [Catalog updates](https://awesomecua.com/updates/index.md): scan schedule and the latest completed scan

## FAQ

### What is Awesome CUA?

Awesome CUA is a source-backed catalog of computer-use, GUI, browser and mobile agents: 5,347 reviewed papers, models, datasets, benchmarks, agents, frameworks, tools and products, each linked to its primary source.

### How many resources does it list?

5,347 reviewed records: 1,718 papers and surveys and 3,629 other resources, including 309 benchmarks, 278 datasets, 475 models, 479 agents, 672 frameworks and 1,162 tools. 1,190 metadata-only bibliography records and 187 scan finds are listed separately.

### How is each record reviewed?

A reviewer reads the primary source (paper, repository, model card or project page) and records the evidence, the review date, and code, data, weights and document licenses separately. Unknown facts stay empty. See the editorial policy.

### How can I read the catalog from code?

Clone the GitHub repository, download catalog.jsonl, or call the JSON API under /api/v1/. Every page has a Markdown version at index.md, and llms.txt lists them all.

### How often is it updated?

Discovery scans run every 8 hours; the latest was 2026-11-11. See catalog updates.

### How do I cite Awesome CUA?

Use CITATION.cff in the GitHub repository, or copy the BibTeX in AGENTS.md.

### How do I suggest a resource or report a correction?

Open a GitHub issue form. A reviewer reads the primary source first.

## Optional

- [Reviewed retrieval documents](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/rag-documents.jsonl), [all retrieval documents](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/rag-all-records.jsonl) and [export manifest](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/rag-manifest.json)
- [Full catalog JSONL](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/catalog.jsonl): every active record, including metadata-only ones
- [API index](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/index.json): endpoint list with counts, byte sizes and SHA-256; [JSON Schema](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/schema.json)
- [resources.json](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/resources.json) ([CSV](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/resources.csv)): Curated resources other than papers: models, datasets, benchmarks, agents, frameworks, infrastructure, tools, products, publishers and learning resources.
- [papers.json](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/papers.json) ([CSV](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/papers.csv)): Curated research papers and surveys, with authors, recorded publication dates, arXiv versions and citation files.
- [categories.json](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/categories.json) ([CSV](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/categories.csv)): Resource kinds and research topics with curated counts and links to their pages, Markdown and data.
- [changes.json](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/changes.json) ([CSV](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/changes.csv)): Catalog events in the 30 days before the snapshot: editorial reviews, new bibliography records and scope exclusions.
- [candidates.json](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/candidates.json) ([CSV](https://awesomecua.com/api/v1/candidates.csv)): UNREVIEWED rows, clearly flagged: bibliography records awaiting relevance review and discovered identifiers awaiting any review. Not part of the curated catalog.
- [Complete curated catalog in one file](https://awesomecua.com/llms-full.txt): every curated record once, compactly; full annotations are in the per-kind files above
- [Atom feed](https://awesomecua.com/feed.xml) and [JSON Feed](https://awesomecua.com/feed.json): the 100 newest reviewed resources
- [Benchmark protocols](https://awesomecua.com/compare/benchmarks/) and [dataset profiles](https://awesomecua.com/compare/datasets/): source-reviewed specifications ([benchmarks JSON](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/benchmarks-profiles.json), [datasets JSON](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/datasets-profiles.json))
- [Reviewed paper BibTeX](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/citations.bib), [CSL JSON](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/citations.csl.json) and [citation manifest](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/citations-manifest.json)
- [Reviewed publication BibTeX](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/publication-citations.bib), [CSL JSON](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/publication-citations.csl.json), [publication observations](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/publications.jsonl) and [their schema](https://awesomecua.com/schemas/publication-observation.schema.json): default arXiv citations keep the recorded preprint; publication editions use their own title, authors and date
- [Topic manifest](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/topics.json): exact reviewed resource IDs, counts, subset URLs and SHA-256 fingerprints; each /downloads/topics/<topic>/ directory serves records.jsonl, citations.bib and citations.csl.json
- [Verified former repository names](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/repository-aliases.json) and [their schema](https://awesomecua.com/schemas/repository-alias.schema.json): use the canonical returned ID for retrieval upserts; aliases add no resources
- [Bilingual data hub](https://awesomecua.com/data/), [中文数据中心](https://awesomecua.com/zh/data/) and [download manifest](https://awesomecua.com/downloads/manifest.json) ([schema](https://awesomecua.com/schemas/download-manifest.schema.json)): file paths, byte sizes, SHA-256 fingerprints, counts and units; compare catalog_sha256 across manifests before combining artifacts
- [Tagged data releases](https://github.com/reacher-z/Awesome-CUA/releases): complete data bundles; verify SHA256SUMS and retain release-manifest.json, source_commit and catalog_sha256
- [Hugging Face dataset mirror](https://huggingface.co/datasets/TIGER-Lab/AwesomeCUA): read-only Parquet and JSONL mirror of these downloads, one config per record type. metadata_only and github_candidates are unreviewed.
- [Computer-use agent survey](https://awesomecua.com/survey/): working manuscript with a separately frozen research inventory; not an additional catalog record
- [Survey bibliography](https://awesomecua.com/survey/references.bib)
- [Survey references JSON](https://awesomecua.com/survey/references.json)
- [Source reading register](https://awesomecua.com/survey/evidence/reading-index.json)
- [Survey file manifest](https://awesomecua.com/survey/build-manifest.json)
